name: MRS.Q: The Surprising Difficulty of Search in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
integration_policy: External baseline only. Do not vendor or redistribute its code in this repository without separate license review.

default_run_settings.default_device: cuda, falling back to CPU if CUDA is unavailable

checked_in_upstream_final_reference_poin.note: Final rows read from results/gym_results.txt and results/dmc_results.txt at the pinned commit. Ten seed values each. These are author-supplied upstream artifacts, not a reproduction by Symthaea.

reproduction_requirements: Pin Gymnasium/MuJoCo, dm-control and all wrappers/physics versions
Match reward transformations, termination, observation preprocessing and action scaling
Run the same number of training timesteps and evaluation episodes
Use matched seed manifests and equal environment interaction budgets
Record hardware, device, wall-clock, inference/search cost and peak memory
Retain raw per-episode outcomes, checkpoints and exact config/source digests

environment_wrapper_defaults.reward_aggregation: sum reward from each underlying dm_control step within one repeated action
environment_wrapper_defaults.observation_transform: flatten OrderedDict observation values in their iteration order
environment_wrapper_defaults.note: Defaults are derived from DmcHyperparameters.action_repeat=2 and DmcPreprocessing.step/max_ep_timesteps at this exact source revision. Verify environment kwargs and task-specific semantics in the adapter.
